**Step 1: Compute the first product**  
\(127 \times 53\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
127 \times 53 &= 127 \times (50+3) \\
               &= 127 \times 50 \;+\; 127 \times 3 \\
               &= 6350 \;+\; 381 \\
               &= 6731 .
\end{aligned}
\]

**Step 2: Compute the second product**  
\(89 \times 47\)

89 \times 47 &= 89 \times (40+7) \\
              &= 89 \times 40 \;+\; 89 \times 7 \\
              &= 3560 \;+\; 623 \\
